player_id.description: Canonical id from player-identity. The `fdy-` prefix is pinned rather than described: the upstream keys players by display NAME, so the one failure this collector must make impossible is publishing a raw upstream string as an identity. A defaulting `resolved.get(query, raw)` is positionally safe and survives end-to-end narrowing tests; it does not survive this pattern.

team.description: Canonical team abbreviation the player is under contract to, or null. Null for the 61 active rows whose upstream `team` is a slash-joined multi-club string whose ordering is not consistent, and for an unrecognised club label.

contract_start_season.description: First season of the current deal (upstream `year_signed`).

contract_end_season.description: Final season before free agency, excluding void years. `year_signed + years - 1` — inclusive of the signing season.

is_contract_year.description: True when scope.season equals contract_end_season. Null, never false, when the term is unknown: false is a claim that time remains.

seasons_remaining.description: contract_end_season - scope.season. Deliberately NOT clamped at zero: a negative value means the source's record of the deal ended before the season captured, which is the loudest available signal that the upstream document is stale.

total_value_usd.description: Full stated contract value, in whole USD. Nominal, never the upstream's `inflated_value`.

guaranteed_total_usd.description: Total guaranteed at signing, in whole USD. Zero is a real value (894 active rows) and is not null.

cap_hit_current_usd.description: Current-season cap charge, in whole USD, read from the upstream parquet's per-season table (`cols[year == scope.season].cap_number`) and scaled from its millions. Null when this row carries no entry for the capture season — 24% of active rows. NEVER derived from `apy`, which is average annual value and is not read at all.

guaranteed_remaining_usd.description: Guarantee not yet earned. Pinned to null with reason `requires_undefined_derivation`: the per-season table carries `guaranteed_salary`, but 'not yet earned' needs a rule about the in-progress season the source does not state. Deliberately not invented.

signing_bonus_proration_usd.description: Current-season prorated bonus share, in whole USD, from `cols[year == scope.season].prorated_bonus`. Null when this row has no entry for the capture season or no proration in it — 40% of active rows.

dead_money_if_cut_usd.description: Cap charge on release. Pinned to null: no column carries it, and computing it needs guarantee-acceleration rules the source does not state. Typing this `null` makes fabricating one a contract violation rather than a code review question.

tag_status.description: none | franchise_exclusive | franchise_non_exclusive | transition. Pinned to null: the upstream carries no tag column.

void_years_count.description: Void years appended to the deal. Pinned to null: the upstream carries no void-year column, so `years` is the stated term and cannot be decomposed.

otc_player_id.description: OverTheCap's own stable key for this player. Provenance and a future crosswalk seed — NOT an identity, and never usable as player_id.

null_field_reasons.description: Why each null field is null, and each value implies a different consumer action. `unsourced_by_upstream` = no column exists, a paid feed would be needed. `requires_undefined_derivation` = the components are present but the source does not settle the definition. `absent_in_upstream_row` = this row did not say. The four permanently-null fields are always present here; a row-nullable field appears only when it is actually null — so a populated `cap_hit_current_usd` carries no entry at all.
